variables.name: TfR_regulation
variables.description: Uptake from transferrin follows TfR1 in liver and other organs: 1 - yes, 0 - no (Enculescu)

variables.name: local_gain
variables.description: Strength of the cell's own iron regulation in every organ: 1 - Enculescu, more - a steeper ferroportin and TfR1 response

variables.name: serum.TfR_liver
variables.description: Transferrin receptors in the liver, relative: 1 = normal

variables.name: serum.TfR_otherOrgans
variables.description: Transferrin receptors in the other organs, relative: 1 = normal

variables.name: serum.Tf_saturation
variables.description: Transferrin saturation: serum iron against the capacity th, 1 = full

variables.name: serum.EPO_regulation
variables.description: Erythropoiesis regulated by erythropoietin: 1 - yes, 0 - no (Enculescu)

variables.name: serum.K_bm
variables.description: Half-saturation of the marrow's iron uptake, in units of the normal serum iron

variables.name: serum.tau_manual
variables.description: How fast serum iron reaches the hand-set level in manual mode

variables.name: liver.local_gain
variables.description: Strength of the cell's own iron regulation (IRP/IRE), both ferroportin and TfR1: 1 - Enculescu

variables.name: liver.TfR_regulation
variables.description: Uptake from transferrin follows TfR1: 1 - yes, 0 - no (Enculescu)

variables.name: liver.TfR_max
variables.description: Upper limit of TfR1, relative; only the rise above 1 saturates towards it

variables.name: liver.Fe_start
variables.description: Iron at the start (steady state), where TfR1 = 1

variables.name: liver.TfR_target
variables.description: TfR1 the cell's iron asks for (IRP/IRE): the inverse of ferroportin's (1 + k_Fe*Fe), 1 = normal

variables.name: liver.TfR_cell
variables.description: TfR1 the cell has, relative; with TfR_regulation = 0 it is kept but does not act

variables.name: der(liver.TfR_cell)
variables.description: der(TfR1 the cell has, relative; with TfR_regulation = 0 it is kept but does not act)

variables.name: spleen.Fe_input
variables.description: Fe amount in spleen: total input

variables.name: spleen.Fe_output
variables.description: Fe amount in spleen: total output

variables.name: spleen.local_gain
variables.description: Strength of the cell's own iron regulation (IRP/IRE), both ferroportin and TfR1: 1 - Enculescu

variables.name: spleen.Fe_start
variables.description: Iron at the start (steady state), the point local_gain turns the response about

variables.name: duodenum.v_max
variables.description: Maximal duodenal uptake from food (SI. Eq.14)

variables.name: duodenum.K_sat
variables.description: Saturation parameter duodenal uptake, corresponds to k11

variables.name: duodenum.Fe_absorption
variables.description: Fe input to duodenum from intestines, prev:in_1

variables.name: duodenum.malabsorption
variables.description: iron malabsorption coefficient: <0;1>; 0 = no absorption, 1 = physiologic

variables.name: duodenum.Fe_loss
variables.description: Fe output from duodenum to intestines (Fe loss), prev:out_2

variables.name: duodenum.Fe_input
variables.description: Fe amount in duodenum: total input

variables.name: duodenum.Fe_output
variables.description: Fe amount in duodenum: total output

variables.name: duodenum.Fe_stool
variables.description: Fe leaving with the stool: food iron not absorbed plus shed enterocytes

variables.name: duodenum.local_gain
variables.description: Strength of the cell's own iron regulation (IRP/IRE), both ferroportin and TfR1: 1 - Enculescu

variables.name: duodenum.Fe_start
variables.description: Iron at the start; fixed, because the duodenum has no steady-state initial equations

variables.name: otherOrgans.FPN_mRNA
variables.description: Fpn mRNA amount in other organs (s11)

variables.name: der(otherOrgans.FPN_mRNA)
variables.description: der(Fpn mRNA amount in other organs (s11))

variables.name: otherOrgans.loss_factor
variables.description: iron loss factor, 1 = physiologic, >1 enhanced loss

variables.name: otherOrgans.Fe_input
variables.description: Fe amount in other organs: total input

variables.name: otherOrgans.Fe_output
variables.description: Fe amount in other organs: total output

variables.name: otherOrgans.local_gain
variables.description: Strength of the cell's own iron regulation (IRP/IRE), both ferroportin and TfR1: 1 - Enculescu

variables.name: otherOrgans.TfR_regulation
variables.description: Uptake from transferrin follows TfR1: 1 - yes, 0 - no (Enculescu)

variables.name: otherOrgans.TfR_max
variables.description: Upper limit of TfR1, relative; only the rise above 1 saturates towards it

variables.name: otherOrgans.Fe_start
variables.description: Iron at the start (steady state), where TfR1 = 1

variables.name: otherOrgans.TfR_target
variables.description: TfR1 the cell's iron asks for (IRP/IRE): the inverse of ferroportin's (1 + k_Fe*Fe), 1 = normal

variables.name: otherOrgans.TfR_cell
variables.description: TfR1 the cell has, relative; with TfR_regulation = 0 it is kept but does not act

variables.description: der(TfR1 the cell has, relative; with TfR_regulation = 0 it is kept but does not act)

variables.name: boneMarrow.v_spl_2
variables.description: Spleen iron uptake rate from bones (k7), 0.008/0.019

variables.name: rBC.Fe
variables.description: Fe amount in red blood cells (s6)

variables.name: der(rBC.Fe)
variables.description: der(Fe amount in red blood cells (s6))

variables.name: rBC.v_spl_1
variables.description: Spleen iron uptake rate from RBC (k10), 0.002 = value for trace exp., 0.004/0.005

variables.name: rBC.blood_drawn
variables.description: Blood drawn so far, all draws together, each as a share of the blood there was (the application adds 0.1 per press)

variables.name: rBC.draw_check
variables.description: How often a new draw (a rise of blood_drawn) is looked for

variables.name: hepcidin.K_ERFE
variables.description: Erythroferrone (1 = normal) at which half of BMP6 is bound

variables.name: hepcidin.Bmp6_free_share
variables.description: Share of BMP6 not bound by erythroferrone, 1 = normal

variables.name: hepcidin.tau_manual
variables.description: How fast hepcidin reaches the hand-set level in manual mode

variables.name: iL6.LPS_given
variables.description: LPS given so far, all doses together (the application adds 1 ug per press)

variables.name: iL6.LPS_applied
variables.description: LPS doses already added to LPS

variables.name: iL6.LPS_infusion
variables.description: LPS given continuously: a lasting (chronic) inflammation; 1 to 5 pg/h covers the whole range of the response

variables.name: iL6.LPS_check
variables.description: How often a new dose (a rise of LPS_given) is looked for

variables.name: erythropoietin.Fe_RBC
variables.description: Fe amount in red blood cells

variables.name: bmp6.Tf
variables.description: Paremeter determining the maximal amount of iron that can be bound to transferrin (k32)
